notes: v4.1 (2026-05-21): six review-driven fixes against the v4 reviewer-agent QA sample. (1) Orphan first-name truncations on long-name destinations are now prevented by the resolver's head-token surfacing step ('Fernando De Noronha' → 'Noronha', 'Bandar Seri Begawan' → 'Begawan'); _fill_pattern also computes pattern-aware name budgets so the resolver gets a tight, accurate budget per pattern. (2) The PKC source-transcription error ('Petropavlovsk-Kamchats, Russian Federation' → 'Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky') is fixed via cleaner diff. (3) 'Cheap Flights to {name}' banned phrase is filtered in both keyword-fallback paths AND in _fill_pattern's post-render guard. (4) Triple-Trustpilot collision: dropped 'Trustpilot rated 4.5★' (headline_patterns) and '4.5★ Trustpilot reviews' (tail_headlines) — kept the pinned '4.5★ on Trustpilot'. (6) Fares-update triplet: dropped 'Fares update every hour' (headline_patterns + cta_pinned) and 'Fares updated hourly' (tail_headlines) — kept the destination-anchored '{name} fares update hourly'. v4 baseline: NO SKU/IATA codes in customer-facing copy — operator constraint. All long-name fallbacks use name-shortening (paren-strip, comma-segment, particle-strip, head-token), never {sku}. discount_led variant carries the MANDATORY 'Save up to {discount_pct}% to {name}' headline pattern (force-injected with fit-aware fallback chain that requires every word of the resolved name to survive). price_led carries the MANDATORY 'Get a great deal on flights to {name} from ${from_price}' description. Every ad group with from_price known must surface ${from_price} in at least one headline or description. Banned/misleading phrases from v2/v3 ('Top-rated travel agent', 'ATOL-style protection', 'Was full price, now -X%', 'Today only: X% off', 'Final seats', 'Last-minute', 'Cheap {name} flights', 'Member, IATA accredited', 'Price Drop Alerts Free', any ' - ' sentence-pause hyphen, any {sku}-substituted customer copy) are removed.

pinning_strategy.headline_2: destination - Pin {name} or '{name} Flights' for relevance
pinning_strategy.headline_3: variant_cta - Pin a CTA matched to the variant's lever
pinning_strategy.headline_4: pattern_interrupt - Promote variant.pattern_interrupt_h4 to position 4 to break OTA parity
pinning_strategy.notes: Headlines 4-15 stay unpinned so Google rotates the strongest combinations, but each variant suggests a pattern_interrupt_h4 the generator can elevate. Compliance > algorithm; cap pinning at 3 unless brand mandates more.

price_led.description: Anchors on the from-price. First-three-words doctrine: number / destination / verb. Used as the default 'price-conscious shopper' angle.

description_patterns.pattern: Get a great deal on flights to {name} with prices from ${from_price}.
{name} from ${from_price}. Lock the lowest fare in 60s.
Real-time {name} fares from ${from_price}. Free 24h cancellation.
Lock {name} from ${from_price}. Compare 800+ airlines side by side.
Compare 800+ airlines for {name}. Pay the airline price, no markup.

discount_led.description: REQUIRED variant for products with discount_pct >= 0.15. Must surface the % in at least one headline AND the canonical 'Save up to {pct}% to {name}' shape (force-injected by the generator with a fit-aware fallback chain when the literal pattern overflows 30 chars).

description_patterns.pattern: Save up to {discount_pct}% on flights to {name} from ${from_price}. Compare 800+ airlines.
Save {discount_pct}% on {name} from ${from_price}. Compare 800+ airlines.
{discount_pct}% off {name} this week. Lock in ${from_price}+ today.
Save {discount_pct}% on {name} when you book direct. Free 24h cancel.
Flightnetwork {name} sale: -{discount_pct}%. Compare 800+ airlines.

social_proof.description: Anchors on real trust signals: 4.5 star Trustpilot, 800+ airlines compared, 1.5M travelers/year, IATA-accredited. Wins on commercial-investigation intent.

description_patterns.pattern: Flightnetwork compares 800+ airlines. {name} from ${from_price}.

urgency.description: Real urgency only. The OTA-specific differentiator is live pricing — fares update every hour, real-time airline inventory. Fake-scarcity patterns (countdowns without deadlines, 'Final seats', 'Last-minute', 'sale ends this week') are removed.

description_patterns.pattern: {name} fares update every hour. Free 24h cancellation.
Today's lowest {name} fare: ${from_price}. Free 24h cancellation.
Real-time inventory for {name}. Lock today's price now.
{name} fares from ${from_price}, refreshed hourly. Pay airline price.

loss_aversion.description: Anchors on the cost of paying the OTA markup. 'Pay the airline price, not the OTA markup.' The Flightnetwork-specific moat — used as the differentiator angle when competitor parity is the threat.

description_patterns.pattern: Stop overpaying for {name}. Lock ${from_price} before fares rise.
{name} fares from ${from_price}. Skip the OTA markup, book direct.
Pay the airline price for {name}, not the OTA markup. Free 24h cancel.
Don't pay full fare to {name}. Compare 800+ airlines, save the difference.

universal.description: Patterns any variant can pull from to top up headlines toward 15. Mostly brand, destination, and generic trust lines that don't carry a strong variant lever.

description_patterns.pattern: Search 800+ airlines for {name} in one click. Real prices, no hidden fees, 24/7 help.
Find {name} fares from real airline inventory. Free 24h cancellation, secure payment.

long_name_fallback_patterns.description: Used when len(name) >= 18 chars, where the full destination name overflows the 30-char headline budget. v4: SKU/IATA NEVER appears in customer copy — patterns use the resolved short-form display name (paren-strip, comma-segment, particle-strip). The customer always sees the destination by name.

description_patterns.pattern: {name} fares from ${from_price}. Compare 800+ airlines, free 24h cancellation.
